summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 9.1 to Angular 10.2 with `ng update`, which ran the core v10 migrations (ModuleWithProviders generic, undecorated classes, @Injectable) and the CLI v10 workspace migrations (browserslist renamed to .browserslistrc, removed options dropped in v10 from angular.json, tslib 2, TypeScript 4.0, updated module/target compiler options, refreshed karma/jasmine/protractor/tslint dev dependencies). @angular-devkit/build-angular was moved to 0.1002.x and @ngrx/* to 10.1.2 so the toolchain and NgRx match Angular 10. install and build pass from a clean node_modules; tests still fail exactly as at baseline, for the same pre-existing reason.
changes: ng update @angular/core@10 @angular/cli@10 bumped all @angular/* packages to 10.2.5 and TypeScript to 4.0.8; the three core code migrations found nothing to change in src/.

CLI v10 workspace migrations: renamed `browserslist` to `.browserslistrc`, removed the deprecated `vendorChunk` options from angular.json's server configurations, dropped the removed `no-use-before-declare` rule from tslint.json, set tsconfig.json `module` to es2020 and src/tsconfig.server.json `target` to es2016, and moved tslib to ^2.0.0.
Bumped @angular-devkit/build-angular to ^0.1002.4 and @angular/cli to ^10.2.4 (ng update left them on the v9 line because a temporary CLI 10 was present in node_modules).
Ran ng update @ngrx/store@10, moving all five @ngrx/* packages from 9.2.1 to 10.1.2; no NgRx code migrations applied.

Dev dependency refresh from the v10 workspace migration: karma 5, karma-jasmine 4, karma-chrome-launcher 3.1, karma-coverage-istanbul-reporter 3.0, jasmine-core 3.5, jasmine-spec-reporter 5, protractor 7, tslint 6.1.
package-lock.json regenerated through npm; verified by deleting node_modules and running a clean npm install followed by npm run build.
manual_followups: `npm run test` still fails exactly as at baseline: angular.json's test target lists "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so webpack cannot resolve the stylesheet and karma never runs a spec. Left untouched to keep this hop to the upgrade; worth fixing on its own.

The v10 migration replaced "module": "commonjs" with "target": "es2016" in src/tsconfig.server.json (this is what the official migration does; the server builder supplies the module format). `npm run build:ssr` is still not green for the pre-existing 'Cannot find type definition file for minimatch' reason, so the SSR build should be checked by hand once that is fixed.

@nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader is still pinned at 7.1.0 with an unsatisfied peer on @angular/platform-server ^7.1.4 and is a no-op under Ivy. Dropping ModuleMapLoaderModule from app.server.module.ts is still pending from the previous hop and will likely become mandatory in a later hop.
The build warns that src/main.ts depends on @angular/platform-server as a CommonJS dependency (new in v10). Harmless, but it can be silenced with allowedCommonJsDependencies in angular.json.
A runtime smoke test of the CRUD screens is worth doing, since the build only proves compilation.
